profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Practical and adaptable Electrical Engineer with a results driven mindset.  Work experience includes a variety of positions, including in testing, troubleshooting, system requirements, and project management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Individual contributor to the verification and validation of the flight controls systems software design for the RaiderX rotorcraft.

positions.title: Engineer Sr. (Systems)
positions.description:
• Directed and lead a team in the test development and conduct of the Virginia Ship Control Maintenance Trainer (VSCMT).  Adopted an organized and systematic approach to procedural writing.  Monitored and controlled test schedule and resources. 
• Conducted formal government testing for the Block IV software release of the VIRGINIA Class Ship Control System (SCS).  Generated test logs, discussed results with subject matter experts (SMEs), and communicated anomalies with government stakeholders.
• Developed and maintained the software and hardware of a small scale test facility for the COLUMBIA class Integrated Power System (IPS) composed of various power electronics and models developed in MATLAB, Visual Basic, and C#.
• Performed qualification and integration testing and recorded anomalies in formal engineering reports.
• Provided stakeholders detailed trade study and technical recommendation to improve long standing computation timing issue.

positions.title: Meter Engineering Intern
positions.description: Conducted walk-down of Blenheim-Gilboa Pump Storage Power Project for Build Smart New York Metering Upgrade Project.  Programmed and tested twenty-two (22) smart multi-function meters for St. Lawrence Barnhart Island Metering Upgrade Project. Created meter block diagram through the analysis of engineering drawings for Willis Meter Project.  Designed replacement metering system and created corresponding engineering drawing mark-ups.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Aided Electrical Systems Supervisor daily on Montefiore Medical Center’s 5-MW Co-Generation Facility. Examined and inspected AHUs and other HVAC systems with experienced Refrigeration Engineer. Shadowed Engineering Operations Supervisor during rounds and routine building maintenance.

educations.schoolName: State University of New York Maritime College

volunteerExperiences.description: Raised funds for our annual scholarship (1.2K)
